readings.meaning: missing, delayed, or damaged package delivery alert

reasoning: An isometric box or cube with an exclamation-point badge clearly communicates a problem with a physical parcel (lost, delayed, damaged, stuck in customs) or a software package error. Both are frequent, high-priority real-world tasks where the alert badge distinguishes an issue to resolve from routine shipping or packing.
